subject: Vendor Assurance: Transition Playbook & Cloud Provider Mapping
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: vendor@sentrycorp.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: Request: vendor roster & cloud mapping for Acme RFP

Hi team,

We're responding to an RFP from Acme Bank (related to deal ACME-RFP-1749) and they have asked for a current subprocessor roster plus a cloud-provider mapping and evidence of region isolation and change-notice windows. Please provide the following by EOD Friday: 

- Updated vendor_roster_v2.xlsx (master vendor list with subprocessors, primary point of contact, and data access scope).
- Diagram showing which cloud provider regions you use for production/staging/backups (PDF preferred).
- Any signed SLAs or addenda that affect residency or failover (redacted as needed).

We need explicit answers to whether any customer data for Acme (US corp) could transit or be processed in non-US regions during routine operations or during failover. If you have planned provider changes in the next 12 months, include the migration window and escalation contacts.

Attachment: vendor_roster_v2.xlsx (template)

Thanks — this is time-sensitive as Acme's security team is gating the pilot.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: SentryCorp Vendor <vendor@sentrycorp.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster & cloud mapping for Acme RFP

Hi Olga / Kimberly,

Thanks for the template. Attached are the items we can share now: cloud_mapping_diagram.pdf and our completed vendor_roster_v2.xlsx. High-level answers below — we can expand if Acme requests more detail under an NDA.

- Residency: Primary processing for our Redwood integration is in BigCloud us-east-1. Backups are replicated to us-east-2. No routine processing in EU/APAC for Acme workloads.
- Failover: In a capacity outage we have an automated failover to us-east-2 within 30 minutes; cross-region replication is async. We do not fail over to non-US regions for US-only customers.
- Planned provider changes: We are evaluating a multi-cloud optimization project for 2029 H1; no migrations scheduled in the next 12 months that would affect Acme.
- Contacts: Security: s-security@sentrycorp.com; Ops lead: j.weaver@sentrycorp.com.

Attachments: cloud_mapping_diagram.pdf (PDF, 140KB); vendor_roster_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 58KB)

Let us know if you want a signed addendum; we can route a minimal residency SLA for review.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships
SentryCorp
vendor@sentrycorp.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T09:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster & cloud mapping for Acme RFP

Team,

I reviewed SentryCorp's submission and there's good coverage, but Acme Security pushed back on the absence of a formal "transition & emergency migration playbook" that we can present. Their ask: a short, step-by-step runbook that covers

- Canary migration plan (traffic split, duration, rollback triggers)
- DNS and certificate change procedures
- Notification windows and SLA credits for cross-region failover
- Data egress audit log locations and confirmation of no non-US processing for US-only accounts

Legal has pre-signed a basic SLA addendum we can request; attaching the redlined copy I pulled (signed_sla_addendum.pdf) — it's minimal and acceptable for pilot customers.

Action items: 
- Olga: consolidate Sentry's diagrams + our playbook skeleton into a single PDF for Acme.
- Rishi: confirm whether our runtime routing policies can enforce region-only routing for Acme workloads (need a short statement we can include).
- Naomi: if you can ping Jordan to coordinate a 30-min call with Sentry / BigCloud to walk Acme's security through the plan.

I'm tentatively scheduling the call for Wednesday (May 17) at 15:00 ET; please confirm availability.

Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: signed_sla_addendum.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: BigCloud Solutions CloudOps <cloudops@bigcloud.example.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, vendor@sentrycorp.com
Date: 2028-05-16T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster & cloud mapping for Acme RFP

Hi all,

BigCloud Support here — confirming the following for the topology SentryCorp described: 

- Region guarantees: bigcloud-us-east-1 and bigcloud-us-east-2 are isolated physical regions; we provide a written attestation for data residency upon request.
- Fast failover: snapshot replication between the two regions is typically under 15 minutes for block-level snapshots; application-level warm standby varies by customer configuration.
- Cross-border movement: we can confirm there are no automated replication paths to EU/APAC for the customer's configured project unless the customer explicitly enables a multi-region replication policy.

Compliance pack link: https://bigcloud.example.com/compliance/us-residency-pack (attestation and SOC-like summary).

If Acme wants a signed provider attestation we can produce a one-page letter for their security team.

Regards,
Amir Haddad
Cloud Operations, BigCloud Solutions
cloudops@bigcloud.example.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: SentryCorp <vendor@sentrycorp.com>, cloudops@bigcloud.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, security@acmebank.com
Date: 2028-05-18T16:40:00Z
Subject: Vendor Assurance: Transition Playbook & Cloud Provider Mapping (final)

All,

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary and next steps for Acme Bank's security review: 

1) SentryCorp confirmed US-only processing for Acme workloads and provided vendor_roster_v2.xlsx and cloud_mapping_diagram.pdf (received).
2) BigCloud provided a compliance pack link and offered a signed attestation.
3) Legal (Kimberly) provided a minimal SLA addendum; we'll request Sentry to sign for the pilot.

Required deliverables before we close the security gate (deadline: 2028-05-24):
- SentryCorp: deliver a concise "Transition & Emergency Migration Playbook" PDF (2–4 pages) that contains the canary plan, rollback triggers, notification matrix, and contact routing. (Owner: SentryCorp, due 2028-05-21)
- BigCloud: provide a one-page signed attestation of US-region residency for the Sentry project (Owner: BigCloud, due 2028-05-21)
- Redwood (Rishi): one-paragraph statement confirming runtime enforcement for region-only routing and how we will apply it for Acme pilot (Owner: Rishi, due 2028-05-20)

I've scheduled a 30-minute joint review on 2028-05-17 15:00 ET (calendar invite sent) to walk Acme through the playbook — recording and notes will be added to the Confluence page.

If we get the three items above by the due dates, Acme Security indicated they will lift the hold for the pilot.

Attachments referenced: vendor_roster_v2.xlsx; cloud_mapping_diagram.pdf; signed_sla_addendum.pdf

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
